lines.2: 「Thanks for coming to school all three days of the break.」
lines.3: 「Today's the last one. Let's give it everything we've got!」
lines.4: 「Let's use this teamwork as fuel and aim even higher!」
lines.5: Since this was our final adjustment day, we went through the whole menu once more.
lines.6: Inter-club relay practice, meetings, the works.
lines.7: Everyone also took turns helping with work on the field.
lines.8: Konoe showed no sign that the gate incident from that morning was bothering her. She kept her chin up, gave directions, and worked.
lines.9: That part of her really was impressive.
lines.11: Before I knew it, evening had arrived.
lines.13: Konoe and I had wrapped up our quota helping decorate the field ahead of schedule.
lines.14: 「Looks like about thirty minutes until everyone else finishes.」
lines.15: 「Let's put the finishing touches on your customer-service practice.」
lines.17: 「Because you're worse at it than everyone else.」
lines.18: 「You really don't know how to rest.」
lines.19: 「When it's time to work hard, I go all the way.」
lines.20: The two of us headed toward the club room.
lines.21: 「...You look weirdly happy for some reason.」
lines.22: 「I was just thinking that, one way or another, I've been spending almost all my time with you lately.」
lines.23: 「T-that's because you're helping the drama club!」
lines.24: 「Once the Sports and Martial Arts Festival is over, that's it! Done!」
lines.27: 「Wait, why am I getting sentimental about this!?」
lines.28: She snapped back with a sharp jab.
lines.30: Maybe she was just cheerful by nature.
lines.33: Even the silence between us felt a little lighter now.
